Facts used:
- Harrowfield’s 2025 budget was 16,021.7 million tenge, and it had 13,904 pupils in 2025/26. (NR-07)
- Tarnvale’s 2025 budget was 12,960.3 million tenge, and it had 10,652 pupils in 2025/26. (NR-03)
- 1 million tenge = 1,000 thousand tenge.

Calculations:
- Harrowfield: \(16,021.7 \times 1,000 \div 13,904 = 1,152.942\) thousand tenge per pupil.
- Tarnvale: \(12,960.3 \times 1,000 \div 10,652 = 1,216.021\) thousand tenge per pupil.
- Difference: \(1,216.021 - 1,152.942 = 63.079\) thousand tenge per pupil.
- Tarnvale’s amount is higher.

ANSWER: Tarnvale | 63.079
